title: Imperial Gardens, teamLab & SkyTree
description: Central Tokyo's cultural highlights — morning serenity at the Imperial Palace, afternoon in teamLab Borderless, evening views from SkyTree. Three bookmarked spots, manageable pace.

activities.title: Imperial Palace East Gardens
activities.description: Freely accessible former Edo Castle grounds. Stone walls, moats, ninomaru garden, and castle keep foundations with panoramic views. Architecture lovers will love the contrast between Edo fortifications and modern Tokyo.
details: ⏰ Open 9:00-16:30 (closed Mon & Fri — Apr 28 is Tuesday)
📷 Suwano-chaya tea house reflection is the money shot

meals.name: Konbini Breakfast
meals.description: Classic konbini run: onigiri (umeboshi or kombu — always veg), salad, hot coffee or matcha latte.

tips.text: 💡 Outer grounds (Kokyo Gaien) with the double bridge are always open — great for early photos before 9:00 opening.

activities.title: teamLab Borderless — Azabudai Hills
activities.description: World's first museum without maps or boundaries. Art flows room to room, projections respond to your touch. Highlights: Crystal Universe, infinite flower room, En Tea House where tea blooms with digital flowers.
details: 📍 Azabudai Hills Garden Plaza B, B1F — Kamiyacho Station
⚠️ GOLDEN WEEK: Book ASAP — sells out weeks ahead

meals.name: T's TanTan — Tokyo Station
meals.description: Legendary vegan ramen inside Tokyo Station's Keiyo Street. All-plant-based tantanmen — rich sesame broth so creamy you'd never guess it's vegan.

tips.text: T's TanTan in Tokyo Station is the GOAT vegan ramen. I went three times in a week. Sesame broth is insanely good.
🎫 Book teamLab for 14:00-15:00 — less crowded than morning during Golden Week.

activities.title: Tokyo SkyTree
activities.description: Japan's tallest structure at 634m. Tembo Deck (350m) gives 360-degree panorama — on clear evenings spot Mt Fuji against sunset. Tembo Galleria (450m) has a sloping glass sky-corridor.

meals.name: Afuri — Oshiage
meals.description: Famous yuzu shio (citrus salt) ramen with vegan option using rich kelp and mushroom broth. Light, fragrant, addictive.

tips.text: 📸 Best SkyTree photos from outside: Jikken bridge on Kitajikken River — the reflection is iconic.
